Perched above Springbrook Country Club on one of Harding's most coveted corridors, The View is a brand-new (2020), boutique luxury elevator building of just six oversized 2BR/2BA residences — 1,330 to 1,700 SF homes with private balconies, designer kitchens, in-unit laundry, and a top-floor penthouse with its own private entry. New construction, irreplaceable setting, golf-course frontage, and downtown Morristown minutes away: this is estate-caliber living in rental form, in a township where almost no one builds and even fewer sell.

Why It Trades
Investment Highlights
New Construction (2020)
Brand-new boutique 6-unit luxury elevator building — one-level living per residence across four floors.
Condo-Quality Residences
Oversized 2BR/2BA homes, 1,330–1,700 SF, with private balconies/patios, designer kitchens, and in-unit laundry.
Golf-Course Setting
Gorgeous views over Springbrook Country Club's green; private, low-density Harding Township location.
Built-In Upside
~5.2% going-in with rent growth on rollover — yield-on-cost climbs as below-market units mark to market, zero capex.
Trophy Address
One of New Jersey's wealthiest townships, where almost no one builds and even fewer sell — true scarcity value.
Minutes to Morristown
Under one mile to Morristown Green; 60-minute direct train to NYC; #1-ranked Morristown Medical Center nearby.
